description: Log time against a FreeAgent project task. Defaults to the authenticated user as the person who did the work. Find the task with freeagent_list_tasks.

comment.description: What the time was spent on

datedOn.description: Date the work was done YYYY-MM-DD

hours.description: Hours worked as a decimal string (e.g. '7.5' for 7h30m)

task.description: Task the time is logged against

user.description: Who did the work (defaults to the authenticated user)

name: freeagent_create_timeslip
